WITH date_series AS (
    -- Generate a series of all dates between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::date,  
        $__timeTo()::date,    
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
train1_readings AS (
    -- Fetch daily flow meter readings from the database
    SELECT
        datetime::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                GREATEST(reset_value, 0)
            ELSE
                GREATEST(daily_flow, 0)
        END AS train_1
    FROM
        public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) 
        AND form_id = 218
)
SELECT
    ds.date,
    COALESCE(tr.train_1, 0) AS "Train 1" -- Replace NULL with 0 for missing dates
FROM
    date_series ds
LEFT JOIN 
    train1_readings tr ON ds.date = tr.date
ORDER BY 
    ds.date;

targets.rawSql:
WITH date_series AS (
  SELECT
    (dt)::date AS date
  FROM
    GENERATE_SERIES(
      $__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',
      $__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',
      '1 day'::interval
    ) AS dt
),
runtime_data AS (
  SELECT
    (open_datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (close_datetime - open_datetime)) / 60 AS runtime_minutes
  FROM
    public.user_sludgewastagedata
  WHERE
    valve_tag = '202-XV-26 Train 1 Sludge Wastage'
    AND $__timeFilter(open_datetime)
),
daily_runtime AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    SUM(runtime_minutes) AS total_runtime_minutes
  FROM
    runtime_data
  GROUP BY
    date
),
final_output AS (
  SELECT
    ds.date,
    COALESCE(dr.total_runtime_minutes, 0) AS total_runtime_minutes
  FROM
    date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN daily_runtime dr ON ds.date = dr.date
)
SELECT
  date,
  total_runtime_minutes
FROM
  final_output
WHERE
  date >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp)
  AND date < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
  AND total_runtime_minutes > 0
ORDER BY
  date;
